children: Eurozone government bond yields rise in opening trade, tracking U.S. Treasury yields and higher oil prices. French government bonds, or OATs, underperform German Bunds amid uncertainties around next year's budget, although Belgian OLOs and Italian BTPs are also under pressure. There is no government bond supply in the eurozone on Wednesday. The 10-year Bund yield rises 1.8 basis points to 3.414%, while the 10-year French OAT yield is up 2.9 basis points at 4.948%, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
